definitions.explanation: A retail establishment where goods are sold. Can refer to any type of shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{店|みせ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{開|あ}いています→開く：00689_aku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧？
examples.english: Until what time is this store open?

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近|ちか}く→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{店|みせ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できました→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: A new store opened near the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{店|みせ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦おいしい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The ramen at that shop is delicious.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{店|みせ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦{九時|くじ}→〜時：09869_ji⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{開|あ}いています→開く：00689_aku⟧。
examples.english: This store is open every day from nine in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧{店|みせ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧、⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}みました→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I went to the shop where my friend works and had coffee.

notes:
{店|みせ} is the general word for any shop, store, or small restaurant.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {店|みせ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to open a shop (for business)
- {店|みせ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}める→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧: to close a shop
- {店|みせ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to enter a shop
- {店|みせ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to open/start a business
- お{店|みせ}: polite form

TYPES OF SHOPS (〜{屋|や}):
- ⟦{本屋|ほんや}→本屋：03034_honya⟧: bookstore
- ⟦{花屋|はなや}→花屋：03136_hanaya⟧: flower shop
- ⟦{八百屋|やおや}→八百屋：02978_yaoya⟧: greengrocer
- {肉屋|にくや}: butcher shop
- パン{屋|や}: bakery

USAGE:
Also used for restaurants and eateries in casual speech: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{店|みせ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦おいしい→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧ (The ramen at that place is good). More formal terms for restaurant include ⟦レストラン→レストラン：01048_resutoran⟧ or {飲食店|いんしょくてん}.
